verdicts.reason: Both have the same main flaw. The building photo, the original's key image, is reduced to a thin strip cut off at the left edge. Its pale background band runs behind 'not/the', and the stacked headline breaks into one or two words per line, leaving large empty areas above and below. A is a little better because its text block is vertically centred, with the photo strip level with its middle. B's text sits lower and off-centre, which makes the image look stranded near the top of the headline.
